input.brief: Redesign the CodeKiln desktop model picker popover: merge open-vetta's three-column picker (provider rail, searchable flat model list, reasoning column) with CodeKiln's own reasoning control (switch plus gradient level slider). Dark app UI, brand orange.
screens: 模型选择浮层：厂商轨 + 可搜索模型列表 + 所选模型的推理档位栏（开关 + 自有渐变滑杆）
搜索态：跨厂商平铺结果，副标题消歧
子模型三态：跟随父会话 / 开 / 关
结构标注：哪件借自 open-vetta，哪件保留自 CodeKiln

stated.mood: CodeKiln 应用自身的深色界面，Kettu 令牌，品牌橙强调色
